settings.label: TEMPO 2.2:1
settings.quote: Tempo ratio 2.2:1 is quicker than the 2.4 threshold (tour average is about 3.0:1 with a downswing near 0.25 s). Let the backswing finish before starting down.

settings.label: SWAY 0.42 SW
settings.quote: Head sways 0.42 shoulder widths away from the target going back (flagged beyond 0.35). Feel like the head stays inside the trail foot at the top.

settings.label: TEMPO SD 0.12
settings.quote: Tempo is impressively consistent across swings (std dev 0.12). Consistency like this is a real asset — low variance is itself a finding worth keeping.

settings.question: How should I film my swing?
settings.answer: Phone at hip height, face-on, ball on a tee — portrait clips straight off a phone work fine. Down-the-line clips get tempo & rhythm only for now; film face-on for the full report.

settings.question: Do I need to trim the clip first?
settings.answer: No. Upload the whole clip — CaddieInsight finds every swing automatically from the sound of the strike and analyzes each one.

settings.question: What does the free plan include?
settings.answer: Three swing analyses per calendar month, free forever. Every analysis produces the full report: metrics table, key-position strip, centerline overlay, slow motion, and coaching notes.

settings.question: How does Pro unlock after I buy it here?
settings.answer: If you already use CaddieInsight, Pro connects to your linked account and you should keep signing in with its current email. If you are new, create your account with the email used at Shopify checkout.

settings.question: Does it work for left-handed golfers?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your handedness when you upload, and every measurement, overlay, and coaching note is computed for a left-handed swing.

settings.question: How long does gear take to arrive?
settings.answer: Training aids ship from partner warehouses. Orders are processed in 1–2 business days and US delivery typically takes 6–12 business days, with tracking emailed at dispatch.

settings.question: What if a training aid isn't right for me?
settings.answer: Unused gear can be returned within 30 days, no questions asked. See the Shipping & Returns page for the details.

settings.question: Can I get a refund on Pro?
settings.answer: CaddieInsight Pro and other digital services are refundable within 14 days of purchase if unused.
